content_text: @EngageSphereDemo just had the best cortado of my life here. you guys are seriously underrated, more people need to know about this place ☕🙌
@EngageSphereDemo waited 30 mins for a simple oat latte on a weekday morning. no update from staff, no apology. this isn't acceptable when the queue is visible from outside
found my new WFH spot 🙌 @EngageSphereDemo has reliable wifi, great natural light and the staff don't glare at you if you sit for 3 hours. 10/10 laptop cafe

@EngageSphereDemo this is the second time in a week my order has been wrong. ordered oat, got whole milk. I'm lactose intolerant. this isn't a minor inconvenience, it's a health issue. please sort out your order process
shoutout to @EngageSphereDemo for always being open bang on 7am. the consistency is everything when you need that pre-commute coffee hit
@EngageSphereDemo included you in our top 5 independent cafes this month! love what you're doing with the single-origin rotating menu. keep it up ✨
@EngageSphereDemo ran out of cold brew at 11am on a Saturday?? please make more. I queued for 10 mins and left empty handed
took a client to @EngageSphereDemo for a catch-up and they were so impressed they asked to reschedule all our meetings there. the vibe is just perfect for creative conversations
@EngageSphereDemo is there a pushchair-accessible entrance? visited yesterday and the step at the front door made it really difficult. would love to know if there's another way in
@EngageSphereDemo the new playlist is way too loud for daytime working. couldn't hear my call even with earphones in. the old ambient music was much better for focus
can confirm @EngageSphereDemo pulls one of the most balanced espresso shots in town. crema was perfect, no bitterness at all. whatever you're doing, don't change it ☕
@EngageSphereDemo any plans to introduce a reusable cup discount? lots of cafes are doing it now and I'd love to bring my own cup and save a bit. good for the planet too 🌱
